1) Volumes we discussed
- Current: ~1.2B tokens / month (inference + embeddings)
- 12-month target: ~3B tokens / month if the new personalization routes and additional models are enabled

2) Budget & unit economics
- You mentioned initial monthly budget in the ~$12k–$15k range (please confirm if that’s net of any credits)
- Target unit economics you’re aiming for: roughly $10–$15 per 1M tokens (you mentioned aiming for a blended $/1M target)

3) Key asks from Acme Health
- A blended pricing approach for the renewal + expansion (you prefer a single blended $/1M rather than separate SKUs for every route)
- Clarity on step-up discounts as volume grows (esp. >1B/month)
- Confirmation on which new routes/models will be in scope (personalization, reranking, embeddings-heavy pipelines)

Next steps I promised: send an initial pricing sketch with tiered step-ups + an example blended rate and an attached formal quote for review. Also looping Rafael (price approvals) on any ask beyond standard discounts.

If the budget guidance above needs correction, please reply and I’ll update. Otherwise I’ll send the pricing sketch tomorrow morning PST.

Thanks Marissa — that matches our notes. A couple of clarifications: 

- Budget: the $12k–$15k/mo range is what procurement has allocated for the immediate renewal term (Q2). That is before any promotional credits.
- Volume profile: the 1.2B/mo is accurate today. We expect to hit ~2B within 6 months and ~3B within 12 months if personalization routes are deployed.
- Target $/1M: we’re targeting a blended goal in the ballpark of $10–$12 per 1M tokens once expanded — that’s what finance would sign off on for a 12-mo commitment.

We’re open to a tiered approach if you can show a simple blended example for our current + anticipated volumes. Also confirm whether adding new models/routes (e.g., reranker + personalization) would change the SKU or simply be covered under a blended rate.

Happy to hop on a 20-min follow-up if that’s easier.

—Alex

Subject: Re: Follow-up & Pricing for Renewal + Expansion — pricing sketch attached

Alex / Samir — thanks, appreciate the clarity. Attached is a concise sketch + formal quote (redwood-pricing-quote-v2.pdf). Highlights below (example pricing, all USD):

Proposed tiered step-ups (public example):
- 0–100M tokens / month: $18.00 per 1M tokens
- 100M–1B tokens / month: $12.00 per 1M tokens
- >1B tokens / month: $8.00 per 1M tokens

Blended examples (applies across routes/models) — illustrative for your profile:
- Current month (1.2B tokens): blended = ((100M*$18) + (900M*$12) + (200M*$8)) / 1,200M = $10.83 per 1M tokens → ~$13,000 / month
- Expected 3B month: blended ~ $9.33 per 1M tokens → ~$28,000 / month

Promotional option for renewal/expansion:
- If Acme signs a 12-month commitment with step-up milestones, Redwood can offer a 10% one-time promotional credit (applied during first billing cycle) and a temporary blended floor of $10.00 per 1M tokens for the first 3 months to ease migration.

Notes on routes/models:
- We treat model variants and inference routes as covered under the same account-level blended calculation; you won’t get separate SKU line items unless you request dedicated capacity per model (that would be priced separately).
- Reranking and personalization are CPU/embedding-heavy; we surface those in the estimate but they fall under the same per-token billing in the proposed quote. If you require dedicated instances for latency SLOs we’ll provide a separate dedicated-capacity TCO.

Next actions:
1) Confirm whether you’re comfortable with the example blended math above and the 12-mo commitment cadence.
2) If yes, Rafael and I will finalize a formal quote and prepare an SOW with the step-up schedule.
3) If you want a 20-min sync to walk through assumptions, I’m available Thu or Fri morning PST.

Attaching formal quote now. Please review and I’ll incorporate feedback.

Best —
Marissa
